{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle plugin: makes the existing bash tool run Git Bash on Windows and disables pwsh.","id":"gh:1335102801","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-gitbash","slug":"yunuo110/dsh-gitbash","topics":["bash","dsh-plugin","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle plugin: makes the existing bash tool run Git Bash on Windows and disab"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Harness (DSH) bundle plugin: makes the existing bash tool run Git Bash on Windows and disables pwsh."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-gitbash"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）bundle 插件：**不新增模式、不新增工具**，在 Windows 上把 DSH 现有的 `bash` 工具直接指向 Git for Windows Ba"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"sh，并隐藏/禁用 `pwsh`，让模型自然使用 Git Bash。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"参考了 Reasonix 的做法。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 设计目标"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **不是 preset 模式**：不需要选择新模式，原有模式名不变。

3. 重新启用 host 层 `tool-bash`；
